provenance.paper_title: DreamRunner: Fine-Grained Compositional Story-to-Video Generation with Retrieval-Augmented Motion Adaptation

evidence.paraphrase: Retrieved video motion references; Test-time LoRA weights. BM25 then CLIP retrieval over the InternVid corpus selects motion references.

Per-scene/character LoRA is adapted at test time (a fixed adaptation mechanism). For DreamRunner, this specifically supports a fixed operational optimization objective of Retrieval-augmented motion priors.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (Retrieval-augmented motion priors) changes through a fixed operational optimization objective; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
